finalText:
**Wrote the 4.2.0 entry into [CHANGELOG.md:3](CHANGELOG.md:3).** Of 380 commits, 13 matter to users.

Three land under `Breaking` even though nobody labeled them that way. Dropping the `v1` export route shipped as a refactor in `#4152`. Nine commits stopped re-exporting the error types. And `fix(auth)` swapped `403` for `401`.

One `feat`: webhook retries with backoff.

Under `Fixed`, the histogram units fix will move dashboards. Worth calling out in the announcement.

Next: decide on the 4 perf commits. Your template has only three headings, so I left them out.
